rule: One x402 door per stablecoin the wrapper roster reads, at /api/wrapper/asset/<asset> (path-scoped, no query, so an index that lists only query-less URLs can list it). A door reads EVERY roster pair whose canonical symbol is `symbol`, live, and hands over one signed card per readable pair. `stablecoin_index_id` is the asset's id in the frozen stablecoin discovery index (public/interop/stablecoin-universe-2026-09/readiness.json); scripts/build_stablecoin_readiness.py reads this file to count asset-specific doors. A door is declared here only when the roster carries at least one pair of that symbol; the test pins both.
